test_case.test_name: Sterss Test - HMC Firmware readiness — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Prove repeated reads of every specified HGX firmware inventory object remain correct and do not destabilize BMC management or generate stress-related platform errors.
required_package: BMC identity, Redfish version and exact availability of all 11 HGX inventory members
Secret injection and certificate/TLS trust policy
Per-member expected Id/Name/Version/Status and allowed volatile fields
100-cycle order, concurrency/pacing, request timeout, total duration and latency/error aborts
SEL and OS log sources/time synchronization plus management-health oracle
test_case.test_command: Resolve BMC/TLS/credential and exact 11-member inventory contract; capture baseline payloads, BMC health, SEL and OS logs; execute 100 numbered cycles over every member with approved pacing and bounded timeouts; retain status, latency and canonical response body for all 1,100 requests; compare stable identity/version/status fields while excluding approved volatile fields; stop on authentication, HTTP, latency or health thresholds; re-query all members and correlate post-run SEL/OS logs without clearing them.
test_case.expected_result: 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test. Criteria : 1. BMC should be functional after stress. 2. BMC SEL and OS event log should NOT have any error message about stress 3. Firmware information for each cycle should be correct."

safety_gate: Never use or reproduce the literal source password; redact authentication material
Do not use `-k` unless explicitly approved; record certificate policy
Bound rate, concurrency and timeout; stop on 401/403, repeated 5xx/timeouts, rising latency, BMC instability or critical logs
Retain all response bodies and failures; do not discard bodies or clear logs
Do not restart/reset BMC or retry an unstable run automatically
expected_evidence: 11-member expected field matrix and baseline JSON
Per-member success/error/latency summary and canonical mismatch report
Pre/post BMC responsiveness, SEL and OS event-log correlation
Abort/recovery evidence if applicable and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Do not conflate this variant with same-code row152. The internal Script must cover all members and never embed credentials.
